map.三种脑膜炎鉴别要点: Key Differentiation of the Three Meningitides
map.脑脊液鉴别需综合判断：化脓性\"高蛋白、低糖、多核为主\"；结核性\"低糖低氯、: CSF differentiation needs synthesis: purulent shows 'high protein, low glucose, mostly polymorphs'; tuberculous shows 'low glucose/low chloride, mostly lymphocytes, moderate protein rise'; viral shows 'normal glucose, mostly lymphocytes, mild protein rise'. Final diagnosis needs microbiology (smear/culture/PCR) and clinical picture.
map.脑膜炎鉴别：比对 CSF 细胞分类、糖氯与蛋白模式。: Meningitis differentiation: compare CSF cell differential, glucose/chloride and protein patterns.
map.术后或随访脑脊液常规复查跟踪。: Post-op or follow-up CSF routine rechecks.
map.教学演示不同类型脑膜炎的 CSF 特征。: Teach CSF features of different meningitis types.
map.中性粒细胞高、糖明显降低、蛋白高提示化脓性；淋巴高、糖近正常更倾向病毒性；需结合: High neutrophils, markedly low glucose and high protein suggest purulent; high lymphocytes and near-normal glucose lean viral; correlate with smear and culture.
map.CSF 糖低就是细菌感染？: Does low CSF glucose mean bacterial infection?
map.最常见于化脓菌，但结核、真菌也可低；需结合细胞与病原学。: Most common with pyogenic bacteria, but TB and fungi can also lower it; correlate with cells and microbiology.
map.侧卧位正常约 80-180 mmH2O，升高见于颅高压等，但受体位与紧张影响。: Lateral recumbent normal is ~80–180 mmH2O; elevation suggests raised intracranial pressure etc., but is affected by position and anxiety.
